Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.
At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.
A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.
At Roblox, we believe advanced research belongs in production, driving core algorithmic advances at a global scale. Machine Learning is a key growth lever, powering everything from real-time 3D generative AI to complex ecosystem economics across our global platform. As an Applied Scientist - PhD Intern, you’ll be part of a community of curious scientists and engineers building the foundational and applied ML methods at a scale of millions of daily active users and billions of daily AI requests. We combine innovative research—including Computer Vision and Graphics, multimodality, NLP, and recommendation systems—with world scaling distributed engineering.
During your 12 or 16 week internship in the Winter, Summer, or Fall, you’ll own a high-impact project from ideation and experimentation to production and publication. There’s also the possibility of continued collaboration beyond your internship, as we support experimentation and production with top researchers, engineers, faculty, and PhD candidates globally that can lead to publications at esteemed venues.
You Will
Prototype, experiment with, and deploy advanced AI, machine learning, and 3D technologies to solve real-world challenges at scale.
Translate cutting-edge research into production-ready features alongside our community of curious, cross-functional engineering and product teams.
Develop, deliver, and optimize solutions that measurably enhance user experience, safety, and creativity on our platform.
You Have
Possess or are pursuing a PhD in computer science, engineering, or a related field, with a thesis aligned to Roblox’s research areas.
Deep expertise in a relevant technical domain, including deep learning, computer vision, NLP, reinforcement learning, or distributed systems.
Proficiency in one or more programming languages (e.g., Python, C++, Go, Java) with experience building and optimizing large-scale systems.
A strong research track record, evidenced by multiple publications and presentations in highly regarded peer-reviewed venues.
You may redact age, date of birth, and dates of attendance/graduation from your resume.

The Data Science & Analytics organization's mission is to increase our speed, frequency and acumen of making decisions at scale by instilling a data-influenced approach to building products. We cover a wide area of the data spectrum including analytical data engineering, product analytics, causal inference, economics, statistical modeling and machine learning. Aligned and partnering with product verticals, we use this extensive toolbelt to discover new opportunities and unmet use cases, influence and shape the product roadmap and prioritization, build data products and measure impact on our community of players and developers.
Teams Hiring for this role:
Foundation AI: Our AI evaluation team focuses on generating high-quality models and consistently improving our evaluation models.
Economy: Drive creator success and growth by exploring marketplace structure and pricing.

Collaborate with data scientists and engineers to research and develop advanced data analytics, causal inference, experiment design and machine learning solutions to power the business and product innovations.
Conduct in-depth research to address complex data-related challenges.
Work on projects that have a real impact on our products, services, and business strategy.
Apply your work to expedite product innovations, including in-experience experiments, friend recommendations, and dynamic resource allocation for experience servers
Present your findings and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Possessing or pursuing a PhD degree in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Applied Math, Computer Science, Economics, or Computational Social Science.
At least 1 year of experience doing causal inference or machine learning or experiment design via research or prior internship.
Proficiency in one or more programming languages (e.g.,SQL,Python or R)
Proficiency in big data query/processing languages and tools such as SQL, Hive, Spark, or Airflow.
Passion for applying scientific rigor to advance dynamic consumer products.
Experience in developing production solutions is a plus.
Experience with ML modeling

Roblox is looking for a Director of Capacity Planning & Engineering to lead the team responsible for translating platform demand into physical infrastructure reality — from supply-demand modeling and hardware procurement through data center deployment and FinOps. This is a high-impact leadership role at the intersection of infrastructure strategy, operational execution, and software engineering.
You will lead a team of approximately 20 people organized across four functional areas and will be responsible for scaling Roblox's infrastructure footprint as it continues to grow rapidly.
What You'll Own
Capacity Planning
Translate platform demand forecasts into hardware requirements
Own the supply-demand matching process end-to-end, working closely with Data Center, Hardware Engineering, and Supply Chain teams
Build and refine capacity models that give the business confidence in infrastructure availability months ahead
Deployment & Delivery
Oversee hardware lifecycle from procurement through physical installation and software provisioning.
Partner with platform and data center operations teams to bring new capacity online reliably and on schedule.
Own delivery execution for major milestones including new data center buildout (Q4).
Data Center Automation (Software Engineering)
Lead a software engineering sub-team that builds and maintains DCIM (Data Center Infrastructure Management) systems.
Drive automation for rack delivery, decommissioning, and capacity planning tooling.
Identify opportunities to scale automation coverage as Roblox's 25+ global data centers expand.
FinOps
Oversee cloud spend optimization and on-prem vs. cloud allocation decisions.
Grow and develop the FinOps function, which is lean today but increasing in strategic importance as cloud spend scales.
Partner with Finance to ensure infrastructure spend is visible, justified, and optimized.
You Have:
10+ years of experience in infrastructure, data center operations, or related fields, with at least 3 years in a director-level or senior leadership role.
Deep expertise in capacity planning and supply-demand analysis for large-scale infrastructure environments.
Hands-on familiarity with DCIM systems and data center automation — this role is lower in the stack than platform software (not Kubernetes/cloud-native).
Experience working across supply chain systems, hardware procurement, and deployment execution.
Proven ability to lead and scale cross-functional teams including software engineers, planners, and operations specialists.
Strong analytical and communication skills; comfortable translating complex infrastructure decisions for C-suite audiences.
Familiarity with AI/GPU infrastructure - Roblox is actively building GPU factory capacity aligned with NVIDIA's next-generation hardware roadmap.
Experience managing a FinOps function or cloud cost optimization at scale.
Background in hyperscale, colocation, or edge data center environments.
Exposure to liquid cooling infrastructure for high-density compute.
You Will
Own a critical piece of infrastructure for a platform used by hundreds of millions of people worldwide.
Scale the team to support ongoing growth and new product features.
Drive improvements in partnership with other engineering teams across Roblox
Create a culture and practice of production excellence, security, and cost-efficiency
Hire and develop senior engineers, managers, and leaders
You are:
Collaborative, low-ego environment where candid feedback is welcomed and acted on.

The platforms in our Engineering Acceleration org dictate how thousands of Roblox engineers ship, and how every backend service gets built, deployed, and kept reliable at scale. They sit on the critical path for production reliability, developer velocity, and security posture. Reporting to Andrew Swerdlow, you will rethink the entire engineering toolchain from the ground up to be agentic-native, creating a world where AI agents are first-class participants in software development and humans set direction and supervise. This is a unique opportunity to define what modern engineering infrastructure looks like at one of the largest platforms in the world.
You will:
Reimagine the engineering toolchain as agentic-native, designing the platforms, guardrails, and feedback loops that let AI agents safely drive migrations, validation, and routine operational work.
Set a bold technical direction for AI-driven quality, including agent-generated tests, automated coverage of untested paths, intelligent verification, and continuous-deployment workflows.
Make software quality and SEV prevention a measurable property of the platform by investing in safe-change mechanisms, automated verification, progressive rollout, and fast, reliable rollback.
Drive down operational toil through automation, transforming manual, repeat work like patching and large-scale migrations into self-serve or agent-driven workflows.
Own and drive the roadmap, aligning cross-pod plans and execution against company goals for safe rollouts.
You have:
Experience leading and growing engineering teams (including managing managers and/or senior ICs), with a strong people-development track record.
Strong technical depth in backend/distributed systems and cloud infrastructure, enabling you to engage credibly on system design and technical decisions.
A track record delivering internal developer platforms, CI/CD, or deployment systems at scale for many internal customers and services.
A strong point of view on how AI/agentic tooling changes engineering workflows, coupled with hands-on familiarity with the modern AI engineering stack, AI coding tools, eval design, and open-weight models.
Demonstrated cross-organizational collaboration and excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate ambiguous, multi-system problems into concrete, executable plans.
(Preferred) Backend proficiency in C# and/or Go, and familiarity with Kubernetes/Nomad (Hashistack), Temporal, and AWS.
(Preferred) Hands-on experience applying AI/agents to engineering workflows, with a background in safe/staged rollouts (canary, feature flags) and incident prevention/automated verification.

As a Distinguished Engineer/Technical Director on Discovery, you’ll be in charge of the overall technical vision and execution for all machine learning initiatives across search and discovery teams. The mission of these teams is to connect a billion users with the best connections and content at the right time, covering a very diverse range of search and recommendation problems at a high scale. This is fundamental to how we personalize the experience to drive engagement and retention for Roblox users. With daily active users growing at a record rate, we are looking for expert tech leaders who are passionate about crafting and building machine learning solutions to power Search and Recommendations.

Own the technical direction and implementation for the machine learning solutions that power the search and recommendation systems, driving Roblox content distribution.
Author specs for new features and improvements. You would be responsible for setting the AI strategy, pushing the frontier of recommendation technology, and driving business outcomes across candidate generation, ranking, objective functions, and value delivery for both users and developers.

Balance researching new technologies with a practical approach to realize the research efforts into the Roblox products
Collaborate with the industry and communities where applicable and be ambassador for Roblox.

10+ years of experience and a consistent record of delivering and improving large-scale search and recommendation systems.
Experience crafting and building large scale machine learning models with billions of parameters and launching them into production.
The capability of breaking down long-term product requirements into iterative deliverable stages.
Initiated and facilitated challenging technical decisions across multiple teams and organizations. You are empathetic and find common understanding.
Deep technical expertise, you always start with the needs of the user, whether they are Roblox users or internal engineers.

WHY DATA SCIENCE & ANALYTICS?
The Data Science & Analytics organization's mission is to increase our speed, frequency and acumen of making decisions at scale by instilling a data-influenced approach to building products. We cover a wide area of the data spectrum including analytical data engineering, product analytics, experimentation, causal inference, statistical modeling and machine learning. Aligned and partnering with product verticals, we use this extensive tool belt to discover new opportunities and unmet use cases, influence and shape the product roadmap and prioritization, build data products and measure impact on our community of players and developers.
WHY CONTENT SAFETY?
Content safety and moderation are paramount to maintaining a positive, engaging, and trustworthy platform experience for our global community. In this role, you will apply your expertise in data science, statistics, and causal inference to strategically define, measure, and improve the detection and mitigation of harmful user-generated content and violative on-platform behaviors. Your focus will be on asset-based content across the platform - including games, avatars, and emerging in-game behaviors - by establishing reliable ground truth datasets and developing robust prevalence measurement methodologies. You will collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Legal, Policy, and Compliance teams, acting as the quantitative expert who guides our defensive strategy against evolving safety threats and ensures accountability and scalable solutions. This is a critical opportunity to build innovative detection systems, define what we measure, and prove the impact of our safety efforts.
YOU WILL:
Establish and monitor robust prevalence measurement methodologies to accurately quantify the overall level of harmful content and behavior on the platform, providing the authoritative source of truth for organizational safety goals.
Develop and validate comprehensive ground truth datasets for harmful UGC and violative on-platform behaviors, ensuring high quality and alignment with the latest platform policies.
Deepen our understanding of violations by conducting exploratory analysis on current and emerging threat landscapes, providing data-backed recommendations on where Product and Engineering should strategically invest detection and moderation resources.
Design, implement, and analyze sophisticated experiments for new moderation and safety enforcement features, communicating results to our primary partners in Product and Engineering to guide development, while also collaborating closely with Policy, Compliance, and Legal teams for full strategic alignment.
Leverage advanced causal inference methodologies to accurately measure the effectiveness and potential systemic impacts of various safety initiatives on player experience and platform integrity.
Communicate strategic insights and present recommendations to leadership and all cross-functional partners, translating complex statistical findings on prevalence, ground truth quality, and effectiveness into actionable strategies for Product, Engineering, Policy, Compliance, and Legal
Partner with ML and Data Engineering teams to ensure model development, reporting, and detection systems are built on statistically sound ground truth and measurement frameworks.
YOU HAVE:
10+ years of industry experience in data science, economics, analytics, or machine learning engineering
7+ years of experience using scripting languages (Python, R), and big data query/processing languages and tools such as SQL, Hive, Spark, and Airflow
Knowledge of ML and Deep Learning either via formal training or industry experience
Ability to apply creative first-principles reasoning to solve ambiguous problems
Experience developing large-scale safety or moderation systems as well as experience with content platforms, specifically user-generated content
Advanced Degree and/or PhD in Statistics, Computer Science, Physics, Applied Math, Economics, or other related quantitative fields

WHY SAFETY?
At Roblox, we strive to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and the Safety organization’s mission is to become the leader in civil immersive online communities. We systematically detect, remove, and prevent problematic accounts, content and behavior, and we make Roblox accounts secure and free from compromise. We cover a broad area of the tech spectrum, including machine learning, classifiers for 3D models, experimentation, automation, detection workflows, and AI-powered text filters. Aligned and partnering with product teams, we use this toolbelt to discover new opportunities, influence and shape the product roadmap and prioritization, build safety products, and measure the impact on our community of users and developers. In doing so, we keep Roblox safe, civil, and inclusive, and we foster positive relationships between people around the world.
WHY ALT DEFENSE?
Safety and Civility is Roblox’s #1 priority. The Alt Defense pod is at the front lines of this mission, tasked with solving one of the most difficult adversarial problems on the platform: Alternate Account Detection and Prevention. When bad actors are removed from Roblox, they often attempt to return immediately with new identities. Our goal is to stop them in their tracks. As the Technical Lead for this pod, you will architect and build an industry-leading detection system that operates at a massive scale—processing billions of accounts and identifying recidivism within minutes. You will also be supporting additional use cases for alt detection across the company. You will report to the Senior Engineering Manager of the Account Identity Team.
You will:
Lead the technical vision for alternate account detection platform, moving from reactive measures to proactive, near real-time prevention.
Architect high-scale ML systems using Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) and advanced clustering techniques to map relationships across billions of entities.
Solve complex ground truth and training data challenges for adversarial usecases
Build for latency and scale, ensuring that detection happens within minutes of a bad actor’s attempt to rejoin the platform.
Develop innovative adversarial approaches to stay ahead of sophisticated actors who use evolving techniques to mask their identity.
Drive the ML roadmap, identifying opportunities to leverage big data and behavioral signals to improve precision and recall in a high-stakes environment.
Mentor and up-level a pod of high-performing ML and software engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence and rapid iteration.
You have:
MS or PhD degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field.
10+ years of industry experience in Applied ML, with a significant focus on anti-abuse, fraud, integrity, or identity.
Expertise in Graph Learning: Deep experience with Large-scale GNNs (GraphSAGE, PGB, etc.) and unsupervised/semi-supervised clustering at the scale of billions of nodes.
Proven track record of leading complex technical projects from conception to production-level deployment.
Experience with high-throughput systems: You understand the nuances of deploying ML models in low-latency environments where "time-to-detect" is a critical KPI.
Adversarial mindset: You can think like a bad actor to anticipate how they will circumvent detection and build robust defenses against it.
You are:
Resourceful: You're adaptable in any situation and can always find a path forward in the face of evolving threats.
Analytical: Excited to investigate large, ambiguous datasets to find the "signal in the noise" of billions of accounts.
User Oriented: You understand that safety measures must be balanced with a seamless experience for our legitimate community members.
Team Oriented: You are a sought-after mentor who lifts up your peers and builds a collaborative, high-performance environment.
Mission Oriented: You are laser-focused on keeping Roblox safe and are willing to take bold, strategic risks to achieve a billion-user scale safely.

Matchmaking is a critical stage downstream of Discovery and Search. Once a player chooses a game to play, matchmaking assigns them to a server for that game. That decision shapes who they play with, the network latency they experience, and the quality of their session. By matching players to servers that fit their needs and each developer’s game, matchmaking helps turn discovery into satisfying play, repeat visits, and long-term engagement, making it a direct lever for Roblox’s growth.
As a Principal ML Engineer on Matchmaking, you’ll own the technical vision and execution for the models, objective functions, and algorithms that make those decisions. You’ll combine predictions of high-value player actions with optimization of player and developer utility and system efficiency, serving millions of players across hundreds of thousands of servers in global datacenters.
You Will:
Own the technical direction and ML strategy for matchmaking, connecting the Discovery and Search journey to server placements that improve player experience, developer success, and Roblox growth.
Define and evolve the matchmaking objective function to balance player and developer utility with system efficiency. Make tradeoffs among co-player compatibility, network and join latency, engagement, retention, server utilization, and compute cost explicit and measurable.
Build models that predict high-value actions and longer-term outcomes for each player–server match, including co-play, chat engagement, sustained play, and return visits, using player history, game characteristics, and live server state.
Design and productionize candidate-server retrieval, ranking, and assignment algorithms that optimize this objective under real-time latency, capacity, and reliability constraints, accounting for both the joining player and players already in the server.
Lead other engineers by example and through technical direction as an individual contributor, mentor engineers, and create an engineering culture of excellence.
Build and evolve the data, feature, training, serving, and evaluation systems that support matchmaking ML, ensuring fresh signals, reliable predictions, and consistency between training and serving.
Partner with Discovery, Search, developer-facing product teams, modelers, and data and AI infrastructure engineers to co-design models and systems that adapt to each game’s needs and deliver value across the player journey.
Define offline evaluation and lead online experiments to measure the impact of matchmaking decisions on player engagement and retention, developer success, and system efficiency, using the results to improve models and objectives.
Translate research into iterative production improvements, collaborate with the wider ML community where applicable, and represent Roblox’s technical work.
You Have:
8+ years of experience and a consistent record of delivering and improving large-scale ML systems for ranking, recommendation, personalization, or resource allocation.
Experience defining objective functions, building predictive models, and deploying optimization algorithms that balance user and business outcomes with production latency, reliability, and resource constraints.
The capability of breaking down long-term product requirements into iterative deliverable stages.
Initiated and facilitated challenging technical decisions across multiple teams and organizations. You are empathetic and find common understanding.
Deep technical expertise, you always start with the needs of the user, whether they are Roblox users or internal engineers.
A generalist approach and you have mastered several languages and technologies already; you can easily adapt to any situation.
The ability to roll up your sleeves to tackle data problems or machine learning problems when they come up.
A creative and strategic approach to solving hard problems. You simplify the complex. You bring in fresh ideas from new places.

The team is accountable for Roblox's machine and workload identity platform, its centralized authorization engine, its production access management platform, production PKI and certificate lifecycle, and just-in-time privileged access for engineers. As an individual contributor in Production IAM, you will define multi-year strategy, drive alignment across Roblox Platform, mentor senior and staff engineers, and personally build the hardest parts of these systems. Lead the architecture for production identity and access. Define and evolve the end-to-end design for machine, workload, human, and AI-agent identity across our hybrid on-prem and cloud fleet, making secure access invisible when it can be and intuitive when it needs attention.
Drive mTLS and workload identity to full production enforcement. Lead the technical strategy for our SPIFFE/SPIRE-based identity platform, service-mesh integration, managed service accounts, and certificate issuance, storage, and rotation.
Advance just-in-time, least-privilege access for engineers. Architect just-in-time, least-privilege, and break-glass access to production, replacing static, long-lived credentials with short-lived, auditable access that stays reliable even during dependency or identity-provider outages.
Evolve the centralized authorization engine and a secure golden path. Mature our centralized authorization engine and the access-control models behind it (RBAC/ABAC and risk-based access) so decisions are consistent, fine-grained, and testable.
Pioneer identity and access for AI agents. Define how agents obtain credentials, receive scoped permissions, and have their sessions managed across their lifecycle, setting the patterns for agentic identity at Roblox..
Lead across the org and raise the bar. Author RFCs and multi-year roadmaps, align stakeholders across Roblox Platform, mentor senior and staff engineers, and raise the technical bar through design review, on-call ownership, and hiring.

8+ years of relevant professional experience building scalable, distributed backend systems, with a track record of driving architecture end to end.
Deep expertise in identity and access management — authentication, authorization, and access-control models such as RBAC, ABAC, or risk-based access control.
Hands-on experience with several of: PKI and certificate/key lifecycle management, mTLS, SPIFFE/SPIRE or comparable workload-identity systems, service mesh, secret management (e.g., Vault), and privileged access management (PAM).
Proficiency in at least one systems language such as Go, Rust, Java, C++, Python, or C# .NET, and a habit of building systems rather than only configuring vendor tools.
Experience leading the technical work of other engineers — setting direction across teams, writing influential design docs, and mentoring senior talent.
AI fluency: you use AI tools in your daily workflow, understand LLM capabilities and limitations, and can reason about what it means to give an AI agent an identity and permissions.
A Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a similar technical field.

A systems thinker. You reason about failure modes, blast radius, and reliability, and you design access that stays secure and available even when dependencies fail.
Security-minded and pragmatic. You are passionate about least privilege and zero trust, but you optimize for the Builder experience and adoption, not controls for their own sake.
A force multiplier. You make the engineers and teams around you better through mentorship, clear writing, and high-quality technical leadership.
A strong communicator. You translate deep technical tradeoffs for both engineers and executives, and you build alignment across organizational boundaries.
Bar-raising and hands-on. You still love to build, and you set the standard for engineering quality on the hardest problems.

Why Roblox & Agent Infra
The Agent Infra team builds the infrastructure that runs autonomous AI agents at Roblox for millions of creators building experiences on our platform, and for thousands of Roblox engineers shipping production code every day.
Agent workloads break the assumptions most infrastructure is built on. They run for hours instead of milliseconds, they’re non-deterministic, they execute code nobody wrote, and they need real credentials against real systems to be useful at all. Making that safe, durable, and cost-effective at Roblox’s scale is the hard problem our team is solving.
As an early member of the Agent Infra team, you’ll work alongside an experienced engineering team on systems that are already in front of real users, at scale, in a field that didn’t exist two years ago.
You Are
Demonstrated experience: 8+ years building and operating backend, distributed, or infrastructure systems in production, including systems you designed that held up at scale for years.
Deep expertise in at least one of our core domains: workflow orchestration, scalable backend infrastructure, agentic runtimes, or secure sandboxing and access.
Hands-on: You spend most of your time building, and you write production code in Go, Python, Rust, or similar.
Agent-native: Agents drive your daily work. You’ve experimented with swarms, loops, and orchestration, you have strong opinions on harness and model choice, and you’re constantly evolving your agentic workflow.
Experienced with agents in production: You’ve run agents against real systems, seen how they fail, and know what the infrastructure underneath should do about it.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a similar technical field.
You Will
Set the technical direction: Own the design and implementation of Roblox’s core agent infrastructure, and scale it to serve every internal and external customer.
Drive reliability and security: Keep long-running agents alive through deploys, restarts, and outages. Run untrusted code in sandboxes that keep credentials out of the agent’s reach and control what it can reach on the network. Define the SLOs and observability that hold the platform to account.
Raise the bar: Keep learning and experimenting with agentic workflows, and bring what works to the team and the wider Foundation AI org.
Align across the org: Partner with Security, Engineering Efficiency, and Infrastructure so the agent platform and the systems it depends on are built in the same direction.
Multiply the team: Mentor senior engineers, lead design reviews, and push how far agents can build the agent platform itself.
Nice to Have
Security experience with systems that run untrusted code: sandbox and container isolation (gVisor, Firecracker, microVMs), Kubernetes hardening, network segmentation and egress control.
Experience working with Temporal, AWS, and self-hosted models.
Experience building and deploying production systems on Kubernetes, using GitOps and Argo CD.
Contributions to open source or experience building your own product with real user traction.

Demonstrated technical leadership: framing ambiguous problems, explaining tradeoffs, aligning stakeholders, mentoring engineers, and driving cross-team execution.

.NET runtime internals, GC and allocation optimization, thread-pool behavior, or production profiling.
Rust ownership and lifetimes, async runtimes, concurrent data structures, or performance-sensitive library design.
Managed/native interoperability, FFI, native memory diagnostics, or cross-platform packaging.

Roblox's Object Store team is building the in-house, multi-tenant object storage platform that underpins every large-object workload at Roblox — assets, media, analytics, backups, and machine learning datasets — at exabyte scale, trillions of objects, and terabytes per second of throughput. We build and run it ourselves on bare metal in our own data centers, replacing cloud object storage with a platform we control end to end — down to the hardware. As a principal engineer on the Object Store team, you will shape the architecture, build and launch the capabilities that keep this platform durable, fast, and efficient at global scale, and set the technical direction for where it goes next. You will report to the Engineering Manager for Storage.
You will:
Design and build the object store — S3-compatible gateway, metadata and indexing, data placement and tiering, multi-tenancy and isolation.
Own the technical strategy : multi-year architecture, build-vs-buy calls, and the migration off cloud object storage.
Evolve the control plane for elastic scaling, autonomous healing, self-service provisioning, and zero-downtime tenant moves.
Run the bare-metal fleet at scale — cluster lifecycle, upgrades, rebalancing, failure domains, hardware and capacity planning.
Profile and optimize critical data paths; drive down tail latency and cost per byte.
Establish engineering best practices — design reviews, benchmarks, failure drills, post-incident retrospectives — targeting 4+ 9s.
Automate everything : testing, CI/CD, rollout safety, observability, autoscaling.
Mentor engineers and partner cross-functionally with security, analytics, and product teams.

8+ years of experience in software engineering or a relevant field
Deep experience building and operating large-scale distributed storage — object stores, blob stores, or distributed file systems — at petabyte scale or beyond.

Roblox’s data platform powers analytics, ML, and product decisions for a platform serving 200M+ daily active users. As a Principal Software Engineer in the Data Platform Orchestration team, you will be the technical leader for the system that schedules and runs the company’s data workloads. Our team owns Apache Airflow and the Kubernetes (EKS) infrastructure underneath it, running 8,000+ DAGs every day, most of them Spark jobs. You will set the long-term architecture for how Roblox orchestrates data at scale, and you will be hands-on in making it faster, more reliable, and easier for hundreds of engineers to use.
You Will:
Define the Orchestration Strategy: Own the multi-year architecture for Airflow and the surrounding platform, including scheduler and executor design, multi-tenancy, upgrades and migrations, and where the platform should evolve next.
Scale and Harden Airflow: Find and remove scaling limits across the scheduler, metadata database, executors, and DAG parsing. Make sure thousands of daily DAGs run with predictable latency and strong SLAs.
Own Orchestration on Kubernetes: Lead the design and operation of our EKS clusters for orchestration and Spark workloads, including autoscaling, resource isolation, cost efficiency, and deployment automation.
Build Platform Tooling for Internal Engineers: Design the APIs, custom operators and providers, libraries, and self-service tooling that let data teams build, deploy, and monitor pipelines safely.
Drive Observability and Reliability: Establish SLOs, alerting, and diagnostics for pipelines and platform components. Lead incident reviews and fix the root causes in code, not just in runbooks.
Lead Across Teams: Work with data platform, governance, data science, and product engineering teams to align roadmaps, guide technical decisions, and build consensus on complex initiatives.
Raise the Engineering Bar: Set standards for code quality, design, and operational readiness. Mentor staff, senior, and mid-level engineers.
You Have:
B.S. equivalent in CS or sufficient experience.
10+ years of experience designing, building, and operating production-grade, large-scale distributed systems.
Workflow Orchestration Depth: Deep, hands-on experience designing, running, and scaling a production data-related workflow orchestrator or job scheduler (thousands of workflows or DAGs a day). Apache Airflow is ideal, but experience with an equivalent system (Dagster, Prefect, Temporal, or a large in-house scheduler) is also welcome. You understand scheduler and executor design, metadata store performance, task isolation, retries and idempotency, and safe upgrades and migrations.
Kubernetes Expertise: Proven experience managing and scaling production Kubernetes clusters on AWS (EKS), including Helm, autoscaling (Karpenter or Cluster Autoscaler), and GitOps-style deployment.
Software Engineering Foundations: Strong proficiency in Python, plus Go or Java, with a record of writing clean, well-tested platform and tooling code. You are a software engineer who builds and improves systems, not someone who mainly handles tickets and operations.
Data Workload Familiarity: Working knowledge of how Spark jobs run on Kubernetes (Spark on K8s, spark-operator, or EMR on EKS) and how orchestration interacts with them.
Platform Mindset: Experience building platforms used by other engineers, with strong instincts for APIs, observability, reliability, and developer experience.
Cross-Organizational Technical Leadership: A track record of influencing direction across a large engineering organization and driving multi-quarter projects from concept to production.
Extreme Ownership: You define the problem when requirements are unclear, unblock dependencies, and see complex work through to stable production.

Contributions to Apache Airflow or related open-source projects (Airflow providers, Helm chart, spark-operator, Karpenter, Argo CD).
Experience with other orchestration systems (Dagster, Temporal, Argo Workflows, Flyte) and the judgment to know when each fits.
Experience with Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code, Prometheus/OpenTelemetry, and cost optimization or chargeback for shared platforms.
Experience operating infrastructure at consumer-internet scale.

12+ years of experience in software engineering or a relevant field
Deep experience with building and operating large-scale distributed databases or storage engines (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL/InnoDB, RocksDB, Spanner, Aurora, AlloyDB).
Deep expertise in database internals —B-trees, MVCC, WAL, query optimization, buffer management—and strong skills in C/C++, GO or Rust .
Hands-on experience with consensus algorithms (Raft, Paxos) and multi-region replication models that deliver strong consistency and high availability.
Proven success shipping high-QPS, low-latency services on container orchestration stacks (Kubernetes or Nomad) with comprehensive observability.

Why Data Science And Engineering
The Data Science & Engineering organization's mission is to increase our speed, frequency, and acumen in making decisions at scale by instilling a data-influenced approach to building products. We cover a wide area of the data spectrum, including analytical data engineering, product analytics, experimentation, causal inference, statistical modeling, and machine learning. Aligned and partnering with product verticals, we use this extensive tool belt to discover new opportunities and unmet use cases, influence and shape the product roadmap and prioritization, build data products, and measure impact on our community of players and developers.
In Data Science & Engineering, you will build the macroeconomic models, simulation frameworks, and policy mechanics that scale Roblox’s virtual economy. By analyzing Robux currency dynamics, global pricing strategies, and developer exchange policies, your work will directly inform strategic decision-making, financial policy, and executive roadmaps on our road to connecting one billion users.
You will:
Develop, build, and refine macroeconomic models to forecast and monitor Robux money supply, velocity, inflation/deflation dynamics, and overall virtual economy health.
Model and inform comprehensive currency exchange policies , encompassing fiat-to-Robux purchase pricing, regional purchasing power (PPP) adjustments, and Developer Exchange (DevEx) rates, to balance global user participation, developer incentives, and long-term platform sustainability.
Design and run counterfactual simulations (e.g. causal inference frameworks, agent-based modeling) to evaluate the impact of proposed monetary policies, sink/faucet adjustments, and marketplace fee changes before execution.
Analyze sink and faucet dynamics across the platform to balance liquidity, optimize developer economy mechanics, and prevent systemic economic imbalances.
Partner closely with Product and Finance leadership to translate complex economic data into actionable policy recommendations and sustainable growth strategies.
Establish robust economic indicators and monitoring systems to track real-time macro-health metrics, liquidity risks, and structural shifts in user behavior.
Communicate complex strategic findings and macroeconomic trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders to directly influence company-level roadmaps and economic policy decisions.
Promote technical excellence in quantitative policy analysis, econometrics, and simulation methodologies across the broader Data Science and Engineering team.
You have:
5+ years of industry or research experience applying quantitative economic modeling, econometrics, or simulation frameworks to analyze policy, marketplace dynamics, or user behavior.
Deep expertise in quantitative methodologies including time series forecasting (e.g., VAR, state-space models), causal inference (e.g., synthetic control, diff-in-diff), structural macro modeling (e.g., DSGE), and counterfactual simulation techniques (e.g., agent-based modeling).
Proven track record working with large-scale transactional or platform data to analyze micro-level user behaviors and aggregate them into macro-level economic insights.
Demonstrated ability to lead project areas from scratch , translating ambiguous business and policy questions into rigorous quantitative frameworks and iterative research deliverables.
Strong communication skills to explain complex economic trade-offs, risk scenarios, and simulation results to non-technical stakeholders in Finance and Product leadership.
An Advanced Degree (MSc or PhD) in Economics, Econometrics, Quantitative Finance, Statistics, Operations Research, Physics, or a related quantitative field.
You are:
A systems thinker.
Curious and truth seeking.
A deep collaborator. You understand where your skills provide differential value and complement others, and how the strengths of others complement you.
Driven by strategic impact. You are passionate about informing high-stakes company decisions in complex, fast-moving environments.

Senior Director, Generative AI
About the Role
Roblox Build is our generative creation product, the platform where creators design, build, and publish 3D experiences. We are looking for a Senior Director of Generative AI to lead the Applied AI organization inside Build, responsible for turning state-of-the-art foundation models into high-quality, reliable creation systems at Roblox scale. This leader will own the full applied AI stack: model strategy and routing, model adaptation and fine-tuning, code generation (CodeGen), 3D layout generation (LayoutGen), and the evaluation science and infrastructure that tells us what actually works.
You Will
Own model strategy and routing for Build. Design and build an intelligent model layer that selects the right model for each creation task based on quality, capability, latency, cost, and safety, leveraging both frontier models and Roblox-adapted open-source models.
Lead model adaptation across the Applied AI org, including fine-tuning, distillation, synthetic data generation, human feedback pipelines, and preference optimization for Roblox-specific creation tasks such as Luau code generation and 3D scene understanding.
Drive CodeGen capabilities forward by building AI systems that understand creator intent, reason across multi-file Roblox experiences, execute tools, and reliably make complex changes to existing games, going well beyond code completion.
Build LayoutGen intelligence by developing the AI capability that turns a creator's intent into coherent 3D scenes, including object selection, spatial reasoning, placement, aesthetic quality, and iterative editing.
Own evaluation as a core technical discipline. Build the benchmarks, quality metrics, judge methodologies, experiment infrastructure, and human evaluation pipelines that answer whether model, prompt, or routing changes actually improve creator outcomes.
Close the feedback loop between model development, evaluation, and production, ensuring that quality signal flows continuously from creator outcomes back into training data, model updates, and release decisions, rather than operating as separate silos.
You Have
10+ years of experience in machine learning and AI, with 5+ years in senior technical leadership roles overseeing applied AI or ML engineering organizations that have shipped generative AI systems into production at scale.
Deep technical grounding across multiple areas of applied AI, including LLM post-training (RLHF, DPO, distillation), model routing and adaptation, agentic systems, code generation, or evaluation science, with enough depth to recruit, challenge, and lead exceptional scientists and engineers in each area.
Demonstrated experience building and leading high-performing organizations that span both AI research scientists and production engineers, including hiring, developing talent, and making difficult personnel decisions.
Strong evaluation fluency, with a track record of building eval frameworks that predict production outcomes, designing benchmarks that measure what matters, and building the infrastructure to run experiments continuously at model, prompt, and routing level.
Experience operating cross-functionally in complex technical organizations, with the ability to influence and align across research, product engineering, and platform teams without relying on hierarchy.
Genuine interest in the creation problem. You find the specific challenge of AI-assisted 3D world creation and domain-specific code generation compelling, not just as a vehicle for building AI systems.
You Are
A builder and a shipper who cares about getting things into production and measuring whether they actually work, not just publishing promising results.
Technically credible across the stack. You can engage deeply with scientists on evaluation methodology, data quality, and model behavior, and equally deeply with engineers on architecture, inference latency, and reliability.
Decisive under ambiguity. You make principled tradeoffs between rigor and velocity, know when good enough is good enough, and can articulate your reasoning clearly.
Direct and honest. You give clear feedback, surface problems early, and create an environment where your team can do the same.
Mission-driven. You care about the people building on Roblox, and you connect the technical work of the Applied AI org to the experience of the millions of creators using the tools.

As a member of the Roblox Security Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) team, you will play a key role in supporting the Security team’s mission. The GRC team is at the heart of Roblox's security organization — empowering every builder to make risk-informed decisions by establishing a portfolio of governing policies and standards, a repeatable and scalable method of assessing and quantifying risk, and a formal oversight process for GRC capabilities across Roblox.
Our program takes a balanced, "right-sized" approach to security governance — combining qualitative and quantitative risk management methodologies, including Factor Analysis of Information Risk (FAIR), to assess and prioritize the security risks that matter most to Roblox. GRC partners closely with Engineering, Legal, Finance, and leadership — including providing regular reporting to the Board of Directors and the Audit & Compliance Committee — to ensure that security risk is visible, well-understood, and actioned appropriately.
The team is in an exciting phase of growth and innovation. We are using engineering to drive automation across risk management, policy lifecycle management, supply chain risk, AI risk, and controls programs. You will have the opportunity to shape how GRC operates at scale and contribute to a collaborative, high-performing team culture that supports Roblox and the broader security organization.

Deep understanding of risk assessment, compliance frameworks, creation of policy, and how to educate organizations on these concepts.

Matchmaking is a critical stage downstream of Discovery and Search. Once a player chooses a game to play, matchmaking assigns them to a server for that game. That decision shapes who they play with, the network latency they experience, and the quality of their session. By matching players to servers that fit their needs and each developer’s game, matchmaking helps turn discovery into satisfying play, repeat visits, and long-term engagement, making it a direct lever for Roblox’s growth.

Investigate model, data, and systems tradeoffs end to end, from streaming data pipelines and distributed training to low-latency inference and production serving. Own the architecture, establish engineering best practices of scalability, reliability, and cost-effectiveness of ML infrastructure (e.g., training, serving, feature). Work closely with data scientists, ML engineers, platform teams, and product stakeholders to design, implement, and operate robust ML platforms that accelerate model development and deployment.
Stay abreast of industry trends in machine learning and infrastructure to ensure the adoption of leading-edge technologies and practices.

Hands-on experience with large-scale streaming and data processing systems (e.g., Kafka, Flink, Spark, Beam) and real-time feature pipelines.

The mission of the Foundation AI group is to enable Roblox Creators to accelerate their workflows and to put GenAI in the hands of millions of users. We envision a future in which experiences on Roblox leverage generative text and speech capabilities to enable new forms of interaction, generative 3D and 4D capabilities to enable new ways to create, and generative video to give creators a level of visual fidelity and motion that has never been available at this scale.
We shipped our 3D foundation model, which takes text prompts as input and generates production ready 3D objects and worlds. We are now building the Roblox Video Model; the Super Upsampler at the heart of Roblox Reality, our hybrid architecture that pairs the structured simulation of the Roblox Game Engine and Roblox Cloud with the photorealism of Video World Models. The engine stays the source of truth for the data model: state, physics, collision, logic, and multiplayer consistency. The video model generates the pixels: higher fidelity textures, realistic lighting, secondary motion, fluid dynamics, and the unscripted detail of a real world. A world model paired with our engine, enables persistent, multiplayer, photorealistic worlds that any creator can build and any player can join.
As the Senior/Principal Product Manager for Video Generation, your job is to put that in the hands of our community. You will take the Roblox Video Model out of the lab and into creator early access, then to a platform capability available to everyone, running on cloud edge GPU infrastructure, scaling toward tens of millions of concurrents, and keeping agency firmly with the creator. You will own the strategy and vision, define how creators direct and control the model.
You will:
Build a vision and strategy for real-time video generation that delights creators and players and leads to industry-defining innovation in world models.
Own the launch to our community — from lab demo, to creator early access, to scaled platform capability — and earn the trust of a community with real concerns about AI in creation by shipping in the open and proving the model serves them.
Define the creator control surface: how creators condition, direct, and constrain the model so their game rules, art direction, and systems are never overridden.
Deeply understand the model capabilities our creators need — temporal coherence, multiplayer consistency, avatar fidelity, prompt and style adherence — and shape the research roadmap against them.
Develop comprehensive evaluation for our models, combining automated metrics with creator and player feedback, and own the quality, latency, and cost curve with research and infrastructure so this scales affordably.
Work across the company — with engine, rendering, creator, safety, and economy — to make generated pixels safe, age-appropriate, and a core part of gameplay.
Manage from vision through the product life cycle, prioritizing by working with creators and analyzing how our model is used, while providing insights to non-technical audiences and holding your own with world-class AI researchers.
You have:
A track record of solving hard problems.
Proven experience building, shipping, or supporting generative media products — video, image, or world models — or real-time rendering and graphics technology at scale.
Experience productizing research: turning model capabilities into product and product signal back into research priorities, with fluency in the tradeoffs that define this space — quality, latency, inference cost, and compute.
A deep understanding of the product life cycle and a history of collaborating with engineering teams and other stakeholders to deliver complex technical products on time.
Experience shipping to large consumer or creator communities, ideally in gaming, UGC platforms, or creative tools.
A Masters degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Computer Graphics, 3D Animation, or Games Production, or a similar technical field.
Passion for driving user-centric product decisions with an inclusive and strategic mindset, comfort in a fast-moving and ambiguous environment, and a high degree of independent drive.

About the role
We build the isolation layers that contain untrusted and semi-trusted code. You will design, build, and harden process sandboxes across one or more of Linux, macOS, and Windows, the last line of defense when something inside goes wrong. This is a deep systems role for someone who thinks in terms of attack surface, threat models, and the exact boundary between trusted and untrusted.
You Will:
Design and implement sandboxes using platform primitives: nsjail, seccomp-bpf, namespaces, cgroups, and Landlock on Linux; the Seatbelt (sandbox_init / SBPL) and related mechanisms on macOS; AppContainer, job objects, restricted tokens, and integrity levels on Windows.
Define and lock down every communication path in and out of the sandbox: syscalls, IPC, shared memory, file descriptors, sockets, brokers, and minimize what each one exposes.
Enumerate and reduce attack surface: kernel syscall surface, broker interfaces, device access, and side channels. Assume the code inside is hostile.
Make deliberate engineering tradeoffs between isolation strength, performance, compatibility, and maintainability, and document the reasoning.
Write threat models, review designs, and respond to sandbox escapes and hardening findings.
You Have:
Deep, hands-on knowledge of the OS security model on at least one of Linux, macOS, or Windows, and the sandboxing primitives that platform provides.
Strong grasp of attack surface analysis: how sandboxes are escaped and how to shrink the ways in.
Fluency in the boundary between sandbox and host (brokers, IPC, syscall filtering, privilege separation) and how to design a minimal, well-audited interface.
Systems programming in C, C++, or Rust; comfort at the syscall and kernel-interface level.
Sound judgment on tradeoffs: knowing when tighter isolation is worth the cost and when it isn't.
A security mindset: you default to least privilege and distrust every input crossing the boundary.
Nice to have
Experience across more than one of the three platforms.
Kernel, hypervisor, or low-level OS internals work.
Fuzzing, exploit development, or red-team experience against isolation boundaries.

The Geometry Scalability team builds the systems that power both Avatars and Environments across Roblox. Our mission is to enable millions of developers to build large, high-fidelity worlds and multiplayer experiences that still run smoothly on phones and low-end devices.
We’re the team that lets Roblox experiences evolve from simple platformers into massively multiplayer, open-world, AAA-quality games. This is a CEO-level priority: how Roblox “ages up” from kids’ games to experiences everyone wants to play, by making higher-fidelity avatars and environments performant at platform scale.
You Will:
Design and ship 3D engine systems for avatar and environment geometry, including mesh processing, level of detail, transcoding, streaming, runtime loading, and related performance systems.
Partner closely with other teams (Rendering, Avatar, Studio) and external developers so that the features you build are directly usable to create amazing experiences.
Profile and improve the performance of our game engine across a wide range of devices, with particular attention to mobile.
Lead by example: drive projects end-to-end, mentor other engineers, and help set a high bar for technical quality and code health on the team.
You Have:
Proven Expertise: 8+ years of professional experience building and shipping high-performance systems in domains such as game engines, real-time simulation, robotics, AR/VR, or similar.
Strong C++ Experience: Deep proficiency in C++, with a focus on writing clean, efficient, and maintainable code in large codebases.
Applied 3D Systems Experience: Demonstrated hands-on experience building at least one production system involving real-time 3D rendering, mesh or geometry processing, LOD, animation/skinning, spatial data, 3D asset pipelines, or GPU/client performance. Deep specialization in one area is not required, but meaningful hands-on experience is.
Real-time Performance Mindset: Experience diagnosing tradeoffs among CPU/GPU time, memory, loading latency, visual quality, and frame-time stability on constrained platforms such as mobile or console.
Ownership in Ambiguity: A track record of driving work end-to-end when the problem wasn't fully specified: defining the approach yourself, seeing it through implementation, rollout, and production consequences; gathering more information when requirements didn't make sense.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer with a deep background in 3D computer graphics and engine development to join the ML Data Pod within the Foundation AI team. In this role, you will build the foundational infrastructure that powers our next-generation AI capabilities.
As the AI landscape rapidly shifts toward spatial and 3D generation, high-quality data has become the ultimate bottleneck. You will be instrumental in solving this challenge by unlocking the Roblox engine as a massive, scalable platform for synthetic data generation.
This is a unique opportunity to bridge the gap between cutting-edge AI research and low-level engine architecture. You will be navigating unmapped territory—shaping how we represent and structure complex 3D data (such as meshes, materials, lighting, and scene graphs) to effectively train state-of-the-art 3DGen models. Ultimately, the synthetic pipelines you architect will directly fuel the frontier AI models that will define the future of immersive 3D content creation for millions of creators worldwide.
Responsibilities
Synthetic Data Generation: Spearhead initiatives to leverage the Roblox engine to procedurally generate the massive, high-fidelity 3D datasets required for training frontier 3DGen models.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with AI research scientists to translate complex model training requirements into actionable engine features, while collaborating with core engine teams to implement them safely and efficiently.
Pipeline Architecture: Design, build, and optimize scalable graphics and engine-level systems capable of generating diverse spatial, geometric, and visual data at scale.
Technical Integration: Drive the technical direction for embedding synthetic data generation workflows into the existing engine architecture without compromising core performance.
Minimum Qualifications
5+ years of experience building and shipping complex, production-grade software systems
Deep expertise in 3D computer graphics, rendering pipelines, and game engine architecture.
Strong proficiency in systems programming (e.g., C++) with a proven track record of writing highly optimized, scalable code.
Experience extracting, modifying, or manipulating programmatic data from within a complex engine environment.
Strong communication skills with a demonstrated ability to bridge the gap between machine learning researchers and low-level systems engineers.
Bonus: Familiarity with machine learning data pipelines, automated synthetic data generation, or 3D generative AI architectures.
Preferred Qualifications
Background in geometry, linear algebra, or related mathematical domains
Experience with graphics APIs or frameworks a plus but not required

Roll out platform changes safely at scale, using feature flags, staged rollouts, and side-by-side validation of old and new implementations, with fast rollback when needed

Experience designing shared frameworks, UI platforms, or core libraries that other engineers build on
Strong debugging and profiling skills, with experience diagnosing client performance issues such as slow startup, visual stutter, and memory pressure across screen sizes and form factors

An agentic mindset and fluency with AI coding tools: you look for ways to automate, delegate, and structure work so that both people and agents can do it well
Strong written and verbal communication skills, and the ability to align multiple teams around a technical plan

Someone who challenges the status quo, asks why we do things the way we do, and proposes better options

Someone who moves fast and is comfortable shipping boldly, and when something breaks, diagnoses it, fixes it, and learns from it quickly

Roblox’s data platform processes petabytes of data daily, powering analytics, ML, and product decisions. The Data Platform Compute team owns the compute layer underneath it: the Kubernetes (EKS) clusters where all of Roblox’s Spark workloads run, and the software that lets engineers, analysts, and ML practitioners submit and run that work reliably and cost-effectively.
As a Senior Software Engineer on this team, you will build and operate the systems that sit between our users and the cluster. These include the Spark job submission service, our internal Spark libraries, interactive notebook compute, and cluster lifecycle automation. You’ll have real ownership, you’ll work on problems where the design is not yet settled, and you’ll help decide which technologies Roblox adopts next.
You Will:
Build and own core compute platform services: Design, build, and operate the software behind Spark job submission, including APIs, scheduling integration, and the libraries users depend on.
Launch interactive Spark at scale: Deliver Spark Connect to support notebook workflows, including provisioning and managing the EKS compute that backs them, with sensible isolation, resource limits, and cost controls.
Run a safe, automated cluster fleet: Build fleet management automation for EKS, such as blue-green rollouts that validate new AMIs and Kubernetes versions before they reach production workloads, with minimal disruption to running jobs.
Make jobs run better without user effort: Develop our auto-tuner, which analyzes Spark history and event logs to recommend or apply job configuration changes that improve performance and reduce cost.
Own batch scheduling on Kubernetes: Operate and upgrade our YuniKorn-based scheduling, including queue design, quotas, fairness across tenants, and version upgrades.
Shape what we adopt next: Evaluate emerging technology such as native Spark acceleration (e.g., Apache Comet). Run rigorous benchmarks on real Roblox workloads and make a clear recommendation backed by data.
Be an owner of reliability and cost: Define SLOs and metrics, build observability, and drive down toil, incidents, and compute spend across a multi-tenant platform.
Partner across the company: Work with data engineering, ML, analytics, and infrastructure teams to understand their needs, communicate changes, and migrate users to better paths.
You Have:
5+ years of experience building and operating production-grade distributed systems or infrastructure platforms.
Spark on Kubernetes: Hands-on experience running Apache Spark on Kubernetes (EKS, GKE, or self-managed) as a platform, including executor and driver behavior, resource tuning, and troubleshooting failed or slow jobs. We are looking for platform builders, not just Spark users.
Kubernetes depth: Strong experience operating production Kubernetes clusters at scale, such as upgrades, node lifecycle, autoscaling, and operators or controllers.
Engineering foundations: Strong proficiency in at least one of Go, Java, Scala, or Clojure , with a track record of writing clean, well-tested, maintainable backend code. Python is a plus, since much of our tuning and analysis tooling uses it.
Cloud fluency: Experience with AWS (EKS, EC2, IAM, S3) or GCP equivalents, and infrastructure-as-code.
Operational ownership: Experience taking a system from design through production operation, including on-call, incident response, and observability.
Technical leadership: Ability to influence design decisions across teams, mentor engineers, and drive alignment on cross-cutting changes.
B.S. in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
Bonus Points:
Experience with YuniKorn, Volcano, Kueue, or other batch schedulers on Kubernetes.
Experience with Spark Connect, Livy, Kyuubi, or other interactive and gateway layers for Spark.
Experience with the Spark Operator, Karpenter, Helm, Terraform, or Argo.
Experience building tooling that uses Spark event logs or metrics for tuning, cost attribution, or anomaly detection.
Experience maintaining internal Spark builds or driving Spark version upgrades.
Familiarity with native execution engines (Comet, Gluten, Velox) or JVM performance tuning.
Experience migrating workloads from YARN/Hadoop to Kubernetes.
Contributions to open-source projects in the data or Kubernetes ecosystem.
Experience operating at consumer-internet scale (100M+ users).

Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering continuous learning and professional development.

Proficiency in one or more systems programming languages such as C#, Go, Rust, Java, C++, or Python.
Strong practical experience with containerization (Docker) and orchestration tools (Kubernetes, Terraform, Helm).
Experience with message queues and distributed data stores such as Kafka, Cassandra, or MongoDB.

What You’ll Do:
Join the Roblox Ledger team and build the system of record for a global economy. Our north star is that all movement of value on Roblox is tracked on the Ledger, and that every unit of value — virtual currency, fiat, or digital asset — is accurately tracked, perfectly balanced, and fully auditable. That makes the Ledger the trusted foundation for our users, creators, and economy.
We are the source of truth for the economy in both directions: every write of value, and every read of it. The same authoritative record that settles a transaction also has to answer the questions people ask about it — balances, history, statements, reconciliation, and analytics — so that read paths do not drift from the book of record. Robux already runs entirely on our zero-balanced, double-entry ledger, and Creator Wallets launch in December 2026. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design, build, and scale the systems that make this true, in a domain where correctness is the product rather than a feature.
You Have:
4+ years of backend software engineering experience, demonstrating proficiency in designing, building, and maintaining robust and scalable systems (e.g., microservices, APIs).
Strong problem-solving skills and experience debugging complex issues in distributed systems.
Experience in managing projects, planning and executing work across different workstreams.
Strong collaboration skills, ability to work across teams and organizations, mentoring and guiding junior engineers.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a similar technical field.
Experience in financial infrastructure, ledgers, accounting, or another domain where accuracy is non-negotiable is highly desirable. Experience building a ledger or double-entry system at another company is a strong plus.
Experience with large-scale data or analytical systems (OLAP, event-driven pipelines, or similar) is a plus but not a requirement.
You will :
Work closely with Finance, product, and other economy engineering teams to make every movement of value correct at the source.
Architect, design, implement, and operate the ledger services that record every movement of value on Roblox.
Proactively identify and address correctness, performance, auditability, and operational risks in systems where a single bad entry is a financial incident.
Design idempotent, exactly-once write paths, plus the reconciliation that proves the books balance and the precision guarantees other teams build on.
Own both sides of the ledger: the write path that records value, and the read path that serves balances, history, and analytics from the same source of truth.
Uphold high standards for code quality, test coverage, and maintainability, fostering the culture of engineering excellence.

Experience building batch and streaming data pipelines and feature stores (e.g., Spark, Flink, Kafka), with attention to data quality and training/serving skew.
You build systems that are easy to debug and operate, and you take ownership of production health, from monitoring and alerting to incident response.

The Game Engine team at Roblox works on the systems that power the experiences at the heart of the metaverse. Our code is the technical foundation in our client, editor, and our simulation servers.
The Game Engine team is broadly split into departments — Audio-Video-Communication, Avatar, Core AI, Digital Matter, Productivity, and Systems. This position is for the Systems Runtime pod.
The Runtime pod builds and maintains the foundational C++ components that power the entire Roblox engine and Studio stack. We own the runtime layer — the performance, efficiency, and usability of the core primitives that every other engineering team relies on. Think of Runtime as the “standard library” and execution engine for Roblox's C++ world. Our ownership centers on three pillars:
Concurrency System — our task scheduler and fiber runtime power how work is parallelized across CPU cores, letting teams scale features across platforms while keeping code understandable and debuggable.
Memory System — we own the engine's memory allocator stack, tracking pipelines, and observability tooling to make memory behavior predictable and prevent leaks and fragmentation.
Profiling and Observability — we build and evolve the MicroProfiler and telemetry pipelines to help engineers diagnose real-world regressions and keep the client fast at global scale.
This role centers on our Concurrency system. You will own the scheduler and fiber runtime that the rest of the engine is built on, research and implement the performance work needed for 3K-player servers and genre expansion initiatives, and act as the point of contact other engine teams come to with concurrency asks. You will debug real production failures across PC, Mac, mobile, and console, and build deep intuition for how compilers, CPU architectures, and operating systems interact. Collaborate with the Gateway and CNI teams to deliver a unified, multi-cluster service fabric that abstracts cluster and regional boundaries from application developers.

Experienced running Kubernetes in production and familiar with the K8s networking model.
Comfortable working with Envoy proxy internals, xDS APIs, and control plane architectures.
Excellent at designing large-scale distributed systems that span multiple clusters, regions, and runtime environments.

Why User Behavior?
You will build the backend systems that fundamentally shift how Roblox responds to unsafe behavior - from reactive, stateless punishment to a personalized, adaptive system that reflects who a user actually is.
You will own core backend infrastructure for a new capability at Roblox: a low-latency behavioral data layer, a centralized rules-and-inference engine, and a unified intervention-delivery framework that together let us treat users based on their real risk profile instead of a single point total. This is a rare opportunity to build foundational, high-scale systems that directly shape how Roblox understands and responds to risk across hundreds of millions of users.
You will feel a deep sense of responsibility building systems that directly affect millions of users, especially minors, on one of the world's largest platforms. Your work will reduce harm, improve fairness, and help ensure Roblox remains a place where creativity and community can thrive safely.
You will:
Build the User Behavior Foundation: Design and operate the low-latency, per-user behavioral data layer that powers real-time safety decisions - aggregating signals like violation history, in-game reports, and behavioral patterns into a single queryable source of truth.
Own the Consequence Engine: Build and evolve the centralized decision engine that combines deterministic rules with ML risk signals into a single, consistent safety decision the authoritative system every consequence flows through.
Own the Feature Restriction Platform: Build a unified, backend-driven framework for delivering safety interventions that any product team can plug into, replacing today's fragmented, feature-specific implementations.
Unify Abuse Reporting: Build the backend that consolidates reporting channels into a single, scalable framework - integrating LLM-based classification, agentic review workflows, and ML models to improve report routing, prioritization, and reporter feedback while meeting global regulatory requirements.
Design for trust and auditability: Build serving infrastructure that meets a high bar for explainability and fairness, since these systems directly determine consequences for millions of users.
Ship code, not just designs: Own end-to-end delivery - from system design through migration, testing, and production operation.
You have:
5+ years of experience building and operating production backend systems at scale, ideally in Go or a comparable statically-typed backend language.
Strong experience designing distributed systems: service APIs (RPC/gRPC), data modeling for high-throughput event ingestion, caching, and low-latency read paths.
Experience building and evolving rules engines, workflow/decision systems, or similarly stateful business-logic services.
Experience with streaming or batch data pipelines feeding a feature store or similar ingestion layer, and comfort partnering with ML engineers who consume that data.
Solid production operations fundamentals: monitoring, alerting, oncall, capacity planning, and incident response for systems with real user-facing impact.
Nice to have: experience in Trust & Safety, fraud, risk, or other adversarial domains; experience with feature stores or ML-serving infrastructure; experience building frontend-agnostic, backend-driven UI frameworks (e.g. server-driven intervention/notification rendering).
You are:
A Systems Thinker: capable of designing infrastructure that other teams (ML, feature teams, policy) build on top of, not just point solutions.
A Pragmatic Builder: scrappy and impact-oriented, comfortable turning scattered, undocumented signals and legacy code paths into clean, well-owned services.
Comfortable with Ambiguity: this space is actively being redefined — you'll help set the standard, not just implement one handed to you.
A Reliability-Minded Engineer: you treat testing, migrations, and oncall as first-class parts of the job, not afterthoughts.
Committed to Ethical, Responsible Engineering: dedicated to building systems that are fair, auditable, and operate with the utmost responsibility toward user safety.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience delivering finished intelligence to both technical and executive audiences.

As a Software Engineer in our Creator Services Communication Pod, you will build the next generation communications plane to power the millions of experiences on the Roblox Platform.
