As an Engineering Manager for Engine Networking, you will lead and empower a team of engineers who help players experience the game as a nearly synchronous world that streams in seamlessly. Just as the nerves in our bodies coordinate our actions and the bloodstream delivers what every cell needs, the network system coordinates all the computers involved while the asset pipeline delivers the content that brings the experience to life. You will oversee the architecture, execution, and career growth of engineers working across real-time state synchronization and end-to-end asset delivery in your quest to communicate every part of Roblox to every player, as fast as physically possible.
You Have:
Managed, led, or mentored engineering teams working on high-performance, low-latency network infrastructure or content-delivery/asset-streaming systems in client/server environments.
Experience driving execution and architectural roadmap for complex multithreaded systems that connect millions of concurrent users worldwide and stream large volumes of content to them reliably.
Proven track record delivering systems supporting multi-platform deployments - from desktop clients to mobile phone clients to console clients - including the bandwidth, storage, and memory realities each platform imposes.
Experience building systems in resource-constrained environments where every CPU cycle and byte counts.
A background in game engine development, game networking, asset pipelines, or content streaming, with deep familiarity in game loop architecture, state synchronization, and how assets are loaded, prioritized, and made available to the running experience. Preferred)
Experience with the asset delivery path - CDNs, caching layers and cache eviction, download scheduling and prioritization, prefetching, (de)compression and decoding, and streaming/incremental loading under tight memory budgets. (Preferred)
You Are:
An engineering leader with 8+ years of total software engineering experience, including experience managing or leading high-performing systems, networking, or content-delivery engineering teams.
Passionate about continuous technical excellence and comfortable guiding technical strategy around low-level Network Stacks, custom protocols, asset streaming and caching architectures, and open-source contributions.
Highly proficient in C++ environments with a deep appreciation for systems-level programming and the underlying CPU/memory behavior (smart pointers, templates, custom allocators) - the same fluency that separates a smooth stream from a stall.
Knowledgeable in transport-level optimizations, Linux networking, QoS, and Congestion Control Algorithms, and thoughtful about how those interact with asset delivery - download prioritization, bandwidth adaptation, and time-to-first-frame - with the ability to help your team navigate trade-offs down to the millisecond and the byte.
An advocate for engineering growth, team execution, operational quality, and driving cross-functional alignment across platform, engine, content, and infrastructure teams.

Powering the creativity of our Marketplace is our community of creators and developers who are building businesses and establishing their brand by selling creations. These creators range from individuals to small businesses to large brands, all of which are attracted to the Roblox platform, community and offerings.
Our Marketplace is a critical component of Roblox’s economy, accounting for a third of economic activity on the platform. As a Sr/Principal Product Manager, you will own the first impression people have when they come to marketplace, our storefront and how we personalize all content on Marketplace
You will:
Be responsible for designing a homepage that supports multiple content types, the UX and the recommendation engine behind it. You will own personalization for Marketplace, ensuring we are using the latest ML techniques, balance monetization and retention and anticipate the needs of what people want during their shopping journey.
Get hands-on with our community, understand their needs, and partner with the engineers, designers and data scientists to build roadmaps.
Balance the needs of a two-sided Marketplace, constantly striving to deliver for our community and consumers, while using a combination of data and research to inform and iterate on decisions.
Be a champion of Marketplace and our Economy across the company and with the community.
Build the future of the Roblox Economy!

5-10+ years of Product Management experience shipping high quality, delightful experiences for either consumers, creators, small businesses or brands that have a high technical fluency. Bonus if you’ve done it in two-sided marketplaces.
Proven track record of how feeds are constructed, balance multiple objectives, scale content types through LLMs along with a deep understanding of personalization systems that power consumer facing feeds.
You have owned both ML systems and the user facing experiences along with business goals (e.g. retention, growth, monetization).
Interdisciplinary experience. In addition to the standard product functions of design and engineering, you have experience working within a multidimensional environment including analytics, business development, communications/PR, and marketing.
Skills to convey complex ideas through written, visual, and verbal communication, always focusing on the reasons behind everything you do. Those skills transition from the detailed and technical for specs to the inspirational for strategic presentations.
Spirit of an Entrepreneur with an ability to contribute to product design, project management and technical ideas.
Skills to execute in a growing environment, with competing resources and priorities, through the product life cycle from planning and development, through launch.

About the role:
Roblox Studio is the creation engine behind millions of immersive 3D games built by creators around the world. We are entering a major platform transition, evolving Studio into an AI-Native IDE where intelligent systems plan, act, validate, and iterate alongside creators to amplify their output. We are seeking a Technical Director, Applied AI to own the technical direction of the agentic AI systems embedded deeply into Roblox Studio. This is a hands-on individual-contributor role operating at the intersection of platform engineering, AI systems, and developer experience, where you will set the technical direction, design the architecture, and write the code.
You will:
Design and build the agentic AI systems at the core of the AI-Native IDE (planning, execution, validation, evaluation) so they are production-grade and reliable.
Decide how Studio uses coding models, agents, retrieval, tool calling, and context management across the Assistant and the broader creator workflow.
Own the quality bar and evaluation strategy , standing up quantitative and qualitative eval pipelines, including human-in-the-loop, so we ship with confidence.
Optimize these systems for latency, throughput, and cost (caching, routing, distillation, quantization).
Bring reusable patterns and best practices to teams across Studio, raising the applied-AI fluency of Studio engineering.
You have:
12+ years of engineering experience , including ownership of large-scale, long-lived platforms.
Deep, hands-on experience building LLM-powered and agentic systems in production, beyond chat-based interfaces.
Strong systems and software engineering skills , with the ability to design the architecture and write the code.
A track record of defining evaluation frameworks for AI product quality, combining automated metrics with human review, and optimizing inference for latency, throughput, and cost.
Strong background in developer tools or IDE-like platforms, with a proven ability to set technical direction and raise quality across multiple teams as an individual contributor.
Preferred Qualifications: Background in coding models or code-generation systems, and/or research experience in reinforcement learning (RLHF, RLAIF, preference modeling) or related model-training techniques.
You are:
An innovative technical leader who wants to build the AI systems that power the creativity of millions.
Product-minded , with a real understanding of developer needs, creator workflows, and how AI systems land in the user experience.
Adaptable and curious , with good judgment about when to build, when to reuse, and when to push a need back to a model team.
Able to operate at the deepest technical levels and still communicate direction clearly to partners.
